title: Cambridge City Council votes to temporarily restore controversial ShotSpotter gunshot detection technology
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Cambridge City Council votes 6-3 to temporarily reinstate ShotSpotter gunshot detection system after fatal July 4 shooting.
A resident assembly will review ShotSpotter's effectiveness and community impact, providing recommendations within a 90-day evaluation period.
Debate continues over ShotSpotter's accuracy, privacy concerns, and its implications for policing communities of color.

title: 4 takeaways from Craig Breslow’s Red Sox trade-deadline press conference
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox trade for Adley Rutschman from Orioles, sending catcher Carlos Narvaez and prospects as part of the deal.
Marcelo Mayer traded to Giants for lefty Erik Miller amid concerns about his hit tools and durability.
Top prospect Franklin Arias seen as potential future shortstop amid roster changes and Mayer's departure.

title: ‘Playbook of destruction’: Markey, Moulton meet for combative second debate ahead of Sept. primary
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Sen. Ed Markey and Rep. Seth Moulton engaged in a heated debate on August 3, hosted by Boston 25 and GBH News.
Moulton criticized Markey for his Iraq war support, while Markey attacked Moulton's defense spending votes and military connections.
Both candidates claimed the progressive label, with Markey backed by Sanders and Warren, while Moulton focused on transit and education.

title: 4 unproven Patriots players who are standing out at training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Eli Raridon, a Patriots third-round pick, is impressing at training camp as a potential TE2 with notable catches.
Undrafted tight end Tanner Arkin is emerging as a strong blocker in the Patriots' run game during training camp.
Rookie cornerback Karon Prunty shows potential, breaking up a pass against A.J. Brown, and gaining valuable experience in practice.

title: After jokes on GBH, state senator says agritourism like corn mazes are serious business
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Senator Jo Comerford proposed a $5 million amendment to boost agritourism in Massachusetts, promoting cultural and promotional activities.
Comerford responded to GBH hosts' jokes about corn mazes, emphasizing agritourism's importance for struggling Massachusetts farmers.
A state report highlights financial difficulties for Massachusetts farmers, prompting the passage of agritourism measures in a legislative agenda.

title: Red Sox trade Marcelo Mayer to Giants for reliever Erik Miller
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox traded shortstop Marcelo Mayer to the Giants for lefty reliever Erik Miller and minor leaguer Carlos Gutierrez.
Marcelo Mayer, drafted fourth overall in 2021, played 114 games for Boston, hindered by injuries and performance issues.
Erik Miller, 28, is a power pitcher with a 2.76 ERA in 38 appearances this season, bolstering Boston's bullpen.

title: Patriots sign former Giants defensive tackle Casey Rogers
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: The New England Patriots signed defensive tackle Casey Rogers, formerly of the Giants' and Bills' practice squads.
Rogers played ten games with the DC Defenders in the UFL, recording 21 tackles and 1.5 sacks.
Rogers joins a strong Patriots interior defensive line group led by Milton Williams and Christian Barmore.

title: 5 things to know about new Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox acquired catcher Adley Rutschman from the Orioles, sending Carlos Narvaez and several prospects in exchange.
Rutschman, 28, has struggled with injuries but boasts a strong defensive record and solid offensive potential.
Drafted first overall in the 2019 MLB Draft, Rutschman has previously excelled in both college baseball and football.

title: 5 takeaways from Day 8 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: A.J. Brown played through a dislocated thumb, securing touchdowns during Patriots red-zone drills on soggy Day 8.
Efton Chism excelled with multiple touchdowns, while a receiver shakeup saw Hollins and Boutte with the second team.
Undrafted cornerback Channing Canada impressed with pass breakups and special teams involvement during training camp.

title: Ballot Brief: Your guide to the 2026 midterms
author: Zipporah Osei
bullets: Ballot Brief offers coverage on governor's race, U.S. Senate, congressional contests, and nine statewide ballot questions.
The newsletter provides takeaways from debates, explainer content, and information on voting deadlines and polling.
Early voting starts Aug. 22; Massachusetts primaries are scheduled for Sept. 1, 2026.
